newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Two Austrian insurance firms to merge - RZB.
newsitem.headline: Two Austrian insurance firms to merge - RZB.

text.p: Two leading Austrian insurers, Bundeslaender-Raiffeisen-Versicherung and Austria-Collegialitaet will merge through setting up a joint holding company, Raiffeisen Zentralbank (RZB) said on Tuesday.
Bundeslaender, which is majority owned by the Raiffeisen group, would own a 51 percent share of the holding, while 49 percent would go to the group around Austria-Collegialitaet.
The merger is scheduled to come into effect on January 1, 1997.
Bundeslaender is Austria's second largest insurance company with a 9.9 percent share of the market. Last year, it reported a premium income of 20 billion schillings ($1.9 billion).
Austria-Collegialitaet Oesterreichische Versicherung AG is the country's leading health insurer and had a premium income of seven billion schillings last year.
